info.name: HW06 CI — Passing Regression Sample
info.description:
This is a representative CI regression subset.

It does not replace the authoritative 114-test execution.

Known confirmed SUT defects are intentionally excluded from the all-pass demonstration and remain documented separately.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get("base_url")) console.log("[SETUP] base_url is not configured");
if (!pm.environment.get("student_id")) console.log("[SETUP] student_id is not configured");

item.name: 00 - Setup
item.description: Documented supporting setup requests. Setup items do not count toward the 114 executable testcase units.

request.description:
Setup ID: SETUP-002
Purpose: Create a fresh normal account
Produces: user_email, user_password
Supporting setup only; does not count as a logical testcase.
Every request includes X-Student-Id: {{student_id}}.

exec: let json=null; try { json=pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json=null; }
const token=json && (json.token || json.access_token); if (typeof token === "string" && token) pm.environment.set("user_token", token);

request.description:

item.name: [TC-API-001] Verify successful login for an existing account-associated matching credential pair

exec: pm.test("[TC-API-001] response object is available", function () {
try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }
pm.test("[TC-API-001] documented successful-login status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("[TC-API-001] successful login returns token and user information", function () { pm.expect(json).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("token"); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("user"); });
